notes:
Account snapshot - enterprise evaluation focused on Dedicated capacity + model-specific tuning. High-level: AstraScale is payments platform (authorization, chargebacks) with strict PCI constraints; goal is sub-60ms median token latency for customer-agent flows, and sustained reranking throughput of ~350 QPS (avg request = 240 tokens).

Key metrics & targets (from AE/SE call 2026-02-28):
- Latency SLOs: p50 <= 60ms token during business hours, p95 <= 180ms. End-to-end response <= 400ms for 512-token chat replies.
- Throughput: baseline 350 QPS for reranking (short contexts), peak burst to 1k QPS tolerated with autoscale/burst config.
- Cost sensitivity: wants to keep monthly infra <= $35k for dedicated GPUs after reserved discount; willing to trade some latency for lower ARR.

Technical preferences & constraints observed:
- Preferred models: open variants validated internally (Llama2-70B, Mistral-xxl). Interest in Redwood-verified quantized variants.
- Context-length needs: two lanes: 8k for live agent context (fast), 32k for dispute investigations (high mem). Will need separate model variants or dynamic kernel selection.
- Quantization: trialing 4-bit (q4_0/q4_k_m) vs GPTQ 8-bit for 70B. Concern about hallucination/regression on critical fields (transaction ids).
- KV cache strategy: reuse across short-lived agent sessions; large persistent caches for 32k investigative sessions. SE suggested sticky routing to same node pool for cache locality.
- Batching: continuous batching for rerank path (micro-batches) but strict latency cap for chat path. Looking at hybrid: batching window 5-10ms for rerank, 0ms for chat.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant under saturation; must avoid any model producing PHI/PII mismatches.

POC & evaluation timeline:
- 2026-02-21: kickoff demo with AE/SE + infra. Walkthrough of Redwood Console dashboards.
- 2026-02-28: SLA + throughput discussion (Fireflies ff_20260228_0912). SE ran preliminary 70B 8k throughput bench; results in Drive csv.
- 2026-03-01: Security questionnaire answered; follow-up on PCI scope (ff_20260301_1430).
- POC plan: 3-week bench: (1) quantization sweep (8-bit GPTQ, q4), (2) batch window tuning for rerank, (3) reserved GPU sizing exercise with 30-day simulated traffic.

SE notes & recommendations made to account:
- Initial reserved pool recommendation: 6 x A100-80GB (or equivalent A10G mix) to hit 350 QPS reranking + 60ms p50 on chat for 8k contexts assuming q4_k_m. Attach pricing deck.
- Autoscale config: base reserved 6 nodes, burst capacity to 10 nodes for peak 1k QPS. Suggest canary policy for new quant profiles with immediate fallback to float variant.
- Model tuning: run quality/regression evals on 500 prompt set tied to PCI fields; require pass threshold before roll to dedicated.
